HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Amavidiyo okholo avela eqoqweni lethu, ukukukhuthaza, ukukuphonsela inselelo lokukwenza ucabange.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Salibonani ekuseni! Izikhathi zeBhayibhili zalamuhla ziyakulinda.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Qala usuku lwakho ngezikhathi zeBhayibhili ezikhuthazayo, ezilungiselwe ukukuqinisa lokuphakamisa umoya wakho.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Salibonani emini! Izikhathi zeBhayibhili zosuku lwakho.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Okuqukethwe kweBhayibhili okukhuthazayo, okufaneleyo ekuphumuleni kwakho emini kumbe ukuqhubeka ukhuthazeka.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Izikhathi zeBhayibhili ezilokuthula ukukusiza ucabange njalo uthole induduzo njengoba usuku lwakho luphela.
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Isivuno sesivuthiwe. Hlanganyela lathi njengoba sabelana ngevangeli lomhlaba wonke sisebenzisa imidiya yedijithali.
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Ukuze bezwe njalo babone uthando lukaJesu ngolimi lwabo, khona lapho abakhona.

Mission.headline: Ilizwi kaliguquki. Indlela abantu ababukela ngayo iyaguquka.
Mission.intro: Sakha kabutsha iqoqo lethu lamavidiyo lamathuluzi kusukela phansi, siletha iminyaka eminengi yomsebenzi wokuhumutsha ezinkundleni lapho abantu sebebuthana khona, bebukela njalo besabelana.
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Iminyaka eminengi yomsebenzi wokuhumutsha, owenziwa ngabalingani abathembekileyo enkonzweni, isakhe iqoqo elilezinkulungwane zezinguqulo zezindimi, ukuze abantu bahlangane lendaba kaJesu ngolimi olubathinta kakhulu enhliziyweni.
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Sakha kabutsha indlela izindaba zevangeli ezilandiswa ngayo ngemifanekiso, sihlanganisa izinguqulo ezithembekileyo lezindlela zesimanje, ukuze ilizwi lihambe ngokukhululeka ezinkundleni, emasikweni lezikrinini.
Mission.teamPointDescription: I-Jesus Film Project yithimu yomhlaba wonke yabahumutshi, ochwepheshe bemidiya, abahleli labadali, abaguqula iminyaka eminengi yolwazi lwenkonzo ibe ngamathuluzi alabo abenza abafundi kuyo yonke indawo.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Ixhumanisa ababukeli lamathuba abonakalayo ohambweni lwabo lokholo, ibasize bathathe isinyathelo esilandelayo ebudlelwaneni, eBhayibhilini kumbe emsebenzini wevangeli.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Iqoqo elikhulu lemidiya yobuKhristu elilezinkulungwane zamavidiyo, amafilimu lezinsiza ngezindimi ezinengi, okwenkonzo lokutshumayela emhlabeni wonke.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ukuphatha amavidiyo, ukusabalalisa okuqukethwe, ukuxhumana lababukeli lokuhlaziya, kwenzelwe ukusiza izinkonzo zifinyelele abantu abanengi ngempumelelo.
Mission.inviteBody: Simema abasebenzi, abadali labalingani ukuthi bangene kuqala. Hlola amathuluzi amatsha kuqala, unike imibono, njalo usize ukubumba imikhiqizo eyenzelwe umsebenzi wevangeli wangempela.
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Ivula ikhasi lomsebenzi we-Jesus Film esigabeni sohlelo oluzayo
